description.value: The Sandman Signature Kamloops Hotel is a multi-storey full-service hotel in downtown Kamloops offering rooms and suites ranging from standard kings to full-kitchen suites. On-site amenities include an indoor pool, fitness centre, seasonal outdoor patio, and two dining venues—Moxies Restaurant and the Shark Club Sports Bar & Grill—making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists needing a hot meal after a long day. The property is pet-friendly, smoke-free, and offers free overnight parking.
